notes.title: Hard Bullet Demo is here!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018960/7c944e672ee9e192b3c999fc3635ae4121db2a15.png
We've been working hard on this new VR game Hard Bullet and now want to gather your feedback.

Shoot, kick, destroy, jump, fly, push, blow up and — most important — have fun in this timekilling unstoppable action game!

Visit the Store Page or Steam Festival to get a Demo and start a mess!

Max Payne and F.E.A.R. -inspired gameplay
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018960/ff06c242693b888dc4dd10ca75d6988adc4854bc.png
We always wanted to bring classic PC blockbusters feeling to VR gaming, so expect yourself to jump, slide, do wall jumps and all this in slow motion!

Made with a special attention for dual wielding gunplay so expect various submachine guns, pistols and shotguns. You'll find classic rifles as well.

Destructions and Physics
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018960/b7fdf0f691b4d4fefad1099ee3b98d282b4de876.png
Inspired by genre-defining classic John Woo movies like Hard Boiled, The Killer, Better Tomorrow, Hard Target

We worked out the best solutions to bring realistic physic destructions and created dozens of unique assets to fill the arenas. Classic locations to mess everything up: offices, warehouses, laboratories.


Current Demo Limitations
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018960/404c28e602f4aad36494bcc7113fcdc68655856c.png

 Please, notice, this is only a Demo Beta Test and does not represent the final Hard Bullet experience.  
 No tutorial. Working on it.
 Weapons: No auto-reloading animations. No customization and limited interactions. Only a few types available.
 Enemy AI: Two enemy characters with a very basic intellect.
 Interaction: Limited character interaction. Object interaction is turned off.
 Gore and dismemberment are turned off. Blood only.
 Realtime lighting and shadows are turned off.
 Inventory: Gun holsters are turned off.
 Sounds: Most of them are placeholders or not balanced yet.
 Grenades and explosions are turned off.



Join our Discord

Talk directly to the devs, share your opinion and ideas with us!
Joining Discord will help you to stay on Beta Test after the Festival.

Probably we'll turn the Hard Bullet Demo off and will release an updated version after a while.
To stay on the latest Demo build you can join the Beta Test through our Discord Server.

Wishlist and Follow us on Steam!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018960/208d04ca37e1a89ae0f5446221d35143377da41a.gif
Add Hard Bullet Steam Page to your wishlist so you'll be ready when it comes.

Steam Forums Feedback

Visit Hard Bullet Steam Discussion Forums and share your feedback there with us!


DISCORD TWITTER STEAM

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018960/9a303a89cb6a0c91c4336acba17ed3d05ccdd550.png

notes.title: Nevrosa: Primal Ritual is here!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018960/11a83c023495bbcc46d93c5bd6ccfaec512b6b1d.jpg
Hello friends, we are happy to announce our biggest game so far — action adventure in open Misty World is launched on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1070410/Nevrosa_Primal_Ritual/

 World Exploration. Travel across vast lands covered with layers of mist, meet unbelievable plant-animal hybrids, that have been ruling this place for centuries, discover gorgeous ruins of vanished civilization and watch breathtaking scenes around you.

 Story full of Mysteries. Story driven adventure as fearless scientist William Conway who finds an unexpected ally in a face of mystic Cursed Cube which possesses great powers.

 Dangerous Adventure. Main resource to control everything — your own blood. Save precious drops for upgrades or load them as ammo into your faithful Vampire Gun.

 Realistic Graphics. Building Primal Ritual exclusively for VR, we worked carefully to improve unique Nevrosa style in all the things around you. Classic horror movies and books like The Mist, The Thing, Hellraiser and even Avatar inspired the design of creatures and atmosphere.

 Voice acting and Soundtrack. New unforgettable themes from talented composer and musician Zakhar Antonov will create a true cinematographic experience. Music reacts according to the game situation. Find out more good music tracks on the records in the Camp to get into the right mood.

We want to thank everyone of you who liked our games and what we do in VR. Only because of our great community it is possible to produce new VR content and take you to new worlds. 

See you in the Misty World.
GexagonVR Team.

notes.title: Nevrosa: Spider Song Page Launched
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1087970/Nevrosa_Spider_Song

Add to your wishlist! Release soon!
In this half-hour story in a small part of the Mist World, you will try some game mechanics and meet some creatures populating Forest zone. Prepare to live through series of unfortunate events that triggered a dangerous journey of Mr. Conway through savage lands of another world.

You will find yourself amid one of the biomes that could be met in the world we are working on. This dark savage forest is full of dangerous creatures. Such tree zones became a home of giant spiders that are much more intelligent than those from our world are.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27922470/dfefd9f8eb141bb2493aff331048e087148859c8.jpg
Core features:

 Story driven fast-paced adventure in unique setting built for VR
 Exploration — Travel across forest lands, find ruins and reveal fragments of the beginning story.
 Unique Weapon — Take a Vampire Pistol that uses your own blood and find the right balance.
 Giant and tiny creatures living their lives and reacting to you.
 Cinematographic scenes and breathtaking moments, realistic graphics and high-quality effects.
 Customizable Locomotion — choose Teleport or Free and tune it for the best experience.
 Symphonic Soundtrack from talented composer and musician Zakhar Antonov reacts to game situations.
 More than a hundred different sounds were created to build unique another world atmosphere.

notes.title: Big January Update for Vive
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25633407/c42a632fba625583628690394d3b23cefea95588.png

Hi, friends!

We are proud to present you these new awesome game modes:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25633407/4e02094607a0f776c84e614d744b485815ae6924.png
Bungee Jump
OK, looks like you are tough enough to make your first VR bungee jump!
Have a drink of warm tea and let yourself fall down from one of the highest city spots... and grab yourself a bottle down there!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25633407/8fdfa632be08ee1f57b917bc456a3cc5c9d47b87.png
Rocket Man — grab your own Shuttle-Rocket and spend your time in our Open City location! You can start a special Boost mode by pressing Trigger on your controller.


Other sweet things we've done to make you happy:

Eject from the seat — now you can eject yourself from Ultimate Booster by pressing the trigger button the second time to finish the ride and have a nice fly! How far will you go?

Big Graphic improvements:

Totally retuned lighting and particle systems. New shadow map looks fantastic!
Reworked start scene and UI.
Texture and design improvements in the City scene, UB and player model.


Oculus CV1 update will come after the Vive update cause we need some time to figure out the best way to deliver this experiences to various Oculus controllers. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Big January Update for Vive
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25633407/c42a632fba625583628690394d3b23cefea95588.png

Hi, friends!

We are proud to present you these new awesome game modes:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25633407/4e02094607a0f776c84e614d744b485815ae6924.png
Bungee Jump
OK, looks like you are tough enough to make your first VR bungee jump!
Have a drink of warm tea and let yourself fall down from one of the highest city spots... and grab yourself a bottle down there!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25633407/8fdfa632be08ee1f57b917bc456a3cc5c9d47b87.png
Rocket Man — grab your own Shuttle-Rocket and spend your time in our Open City location! You can start a special Boost mode by pressing Trigger on your controller.


Other sweet things we've done to make you happy:

Eject from the seat — now you can eject yourself from Ultimate Booster by pressing the trigger button the second time to finish the ride and have a nice fly! How far will you go?

Big Graphic improvements:

Totally retuned lighting and particle systems. New shadow map looks fantastic!
Reworked start scene and UI.
Texture and design improvements in the City scene, UB and player model.


Oculus CV1 update will come after the Vive update cause we need some time to figure out the best way to deliver this experiences to various Oculus controllers. Stay tuned!

notes.title: CV1 update and small fix
notes.content:
Hi, some news here:

Added Oculus Rift CV1 support.
HTC Vive users can pick locations with their hands.

To pick location you need to look at monitor with your head (CV1 users) or point your controller (Vive users).

Than just press A on X-box controller or Trigger on Vive to teleport!
To start the ride press those buttons again.

notes.title: Ultimate Update
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25633407/ae6d711449b5dab0a44ddeffd91d9fda76fcacda.jpg

Hello fellas!

Ultimate Booster opens new ride location — Canyon.

Enjoy beautiful views and greate soundtrack from Totemlost! Ride famous thrill ride simulator to get real sence of speed and height.

Or you can just hang out on the top and enjoy the views with Eagle companion. Go try Eagle Mode!

Don't forget to show UB to your friends and family!

Important improvements:

This game uses Unity Single Path Rendering which gives up to 100% FPS boost! 
Fixed scale and stereo. Now the ride feels much more realistic!
Returned 360 position tracking for Oculus Rift and HTC Vive.
Updated shaders and lights in City Scene.

notes.title: Some bugfixes
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25633407/7d2e58e4491a6d93f2e0328444cb53e77b5dd010.jpg
Hi, friends!

Fixed CV1 support and some troubles with SteamVR.

Download update first.
 Make sure Oculus Home is running  (it should run automaticaly when you plug your CV1) and SteamVR is not (if you see Steam window with green or empty HMD icon — just close it or click VR button top-right of Steam main window to make it inactive).
 Start the game in CV1 mode.
 Have fun!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25633407/22476281b86bfeb3dc3dd88a354782ed3b8b3b3c.jpg
